query:
SELECT s.link_id,l.sync_generation FROM email_provider_subscriptions s JOIN email_links l ON l.id=s.link_id
            WHERE s.id=$1 AND s.generation=$2 AND s.client_state_hash=$3 AND l.is_sync_active AND l.sync_generation=s.generation
            AND (s.provider_id IS NULL OR s.provider_id=$4) FOR UPDATE OF l,s
